Name: Helah
Summary: Wife of Ashur the father of Tekoa and mother of Zereth, Jezoar, and Ethnan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:5: Wife of Ashur the father of Tekoa and mother of Zereth, Jezoar, and Ethnan.
LifeLesson: The mention of Helah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
